The system employs lazy loading to manage memory [S1]:

The evidence explicitly states that 'The list of grids and their contents is loaded on-demand, on modifier evaluation, drawing, user interface or when Python code needs it.' It further distinguishes between loading metadata (`BKE_volume_load`) and loading the actual grid tree and voxels (`BKE_volume_grid_load`). This 'on-demand' loading mechanism is the definition of lazy loading, which is used to manage memory by not loading heavy voxel data until it is actually required.
